NARRATOR
Darkness gathers over our home village. The ancient fire is fading, and only a brave heart can restore its strength.
I will discover why it is fading. No shadow will make me turn back.
Then start on the path at the edge of the village. Listen to the land and protect every living spark.
A golden feather glimmers in the grass... Who left such a light here?
My fire is wounded, Ivan. Gather the sparks together to awaken the Living Flame.
From the top of an old oak, a raven watched Ivan with eyes colder than the night.
Let him seek the light. Every spark he finds will bring him closer to me.
The wells are freezing and the hearths are going out. Find the source of this curse before darkness grips the village.
I will follow the raven and bring warmth back to the village.
My last sparks are vanishing by the old crossing. There, the shadow touches the water.
Then the crossing will show the way. I will not let the fire die.
A shadow stirred beneath the black water, and for a moment the current flowed backward.
This is no river magic. Someone is hiding power behind ancient seals.
You have gathered enough sparks. Join them, and the Living Flame will answer your call.
Let this light drive away the darkness and reveal the path to its master.
The first spark has awakened. Follow its light; it will show the way.
I understand the board now. Next time, the spark will be ours.
With every careful move, the fire grows brighter.
Do not rush, Ivan. See the whole pattern before you move.
The ice has cracked. The darkness no longer seems invincible.
The ice is strong, but every crack teaches us something.
The village feels warmth again. Keep following the trail.
I will not give up. I only need to choose the right order of moves.
The chains have fallen. The raven can no longer hold this light.
Break the bonds around your goal before chasing the sparks.
The old road is open. Beyond it lies the source of the fading.
The crates hide the sparks we need. Clear the space around them.
Your determination is restoring my strength, Ivan.
I was one good decision short. Now I can see it.
The golden feathers are free. They will guide us across the river.
Clear the downward path first, then free the feathers.
I held out. The Living Flame is very close now.
Keep the fire alive until the last move. This trial takes patience.
The first blossom opened on the old apple tree. The village was still pale, but light was returning.
This hearth burns again, Ivan. But my sparks are still fading beyond the river. We must keep the light alive for the whole village.
The well has clear water again. Help us open the granary; the villagers need strength to get through this night.
One hearth is safe. Now we must protect the village's other fires.
